Coca-Cola Brisket
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 7:14pm

Ingredients




1 Brisket, trimmed
2 tablespoons Olive oil
cup Onion, chopped
cup Celery, chopped
1 tablespoon Paprika
2 Cloves garlic, crushed
cup Ketchup
cup Hot water
1 env onion soup mix
1 cup Coca-cola

Preparation

1 Brush meat with oil on all sides. 2 Sprinkle with seasonings. 3 Place meat in large roaster. 4 Add onions and celery. 5 Mix ketchup with hot water and onion soup mix, stir, and add cola, stir again. 6 Pour over meat. 7 Cover and Bake at 350 for 31/2 hours, basting every 1/2 hour.

Comments:
Cresent

Onion soup mix? Really? We need recipes that start with onion soup mix?
